why: Shapes come in pairs: circle, circle, square, square. In each pair the line first goes one way and then the other way (down, up). The square has its line up in figure 3, so in figure 4 the line goes down below the square, like option 2.
trick: Split a series into pairs when two shapes repeat twice.
